about: Positives are the curated Platform Mappings (seed/mappings.json, kind platform), each with its legal justification. Negatives are pairs whose duties share no concrete obligation; a suggestion for one is a false positive. Pairs in neither list are unlabelled and reviewed by hand, so an incomplete gold set never counts a correct suggestion as wrong.
